title: Gentiopicroside-Induced gastric cancer necroptosis via the HIF-1 signaling pathway: A study involving molecular docking and experimental validation.
authors: Xiong, Bo; Fan, Mingjie; Wang, Zhihui; Yang, Xiaolu; Cao, Shan; Shen, Jie; Fan, Beibei
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接研究龙胆苦苷与坏死性凋亡蛋白及HIF-1α的结合，但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅实验验证，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Gentiopicroside is an effective treatment for several types of cancer, inducing numerous forms of programmed cancer cell death. However, there are few investigations into the role of necroptosis. By utilizing molecular docking, and experimental validation, this study aims to investigate whether gentiopicroside elicits necroptosis in gastric cancer. METHODS: Using software PyMOL and AutoDock, gentiopicroside was docked with RIPK1, RIPK3, MLKL and HIF-1alpha proteins. And a cell study was performed based on SGC7901 cells. The necroptosis-related proteins and HIF-1 signaling pathways were explored using western blot (WB) analysis. Finally, an animal study was performed to test the inhibitory effect in vivo. RESULTS: Docking studies indicated that the docking energies of gentiopicroside to necroptosis-related proteins and necroptosis-characteristic proteins are all below -5 kcal/mol. Additionally, gentiopicroside cells reduce gastric cancer viability and inhibit proliferation. Results from the animal experiments indicated that gentiopicroside inhibits the growth of the gastric cancer xenograft tumor. Western blot and immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining demonstrated that gentiopicroside higher p-receptor-interacting protein kinase 3(p-RIPK3) levels in vitro and in vivo. CONCLUSION: The findings of this study revealed that necroptosis is involved in the inhibitory effect of gentiopicroside toward gastric cancer.
abstract_zh: 目的：龙胆苦苷是多种癌症的有效治疗药物，可诱导多种形式的程序性癌细胞死亡。然而，关于坏死性凋亡作用的研究较少。本研究通过分子对接和实验验证，旨在探讨龙胆苦苷是否在胃癌中引发坏死性凋亡。方法：使用软件PyMOL和AutoDock，将龙胆苦苷与RIPK1、RIPK3、MLKL和HIF-1α蛋白进行对接。并基于SGC7901细胞进行了细胞研究。使用蛋白质印迹（WB）分析探索坏死性凋亡相关蛋白和HIF-1信号通路。最后，进行了动物研究以测试体内抑制效果。结果：对接研究表明，龙胆苦苷与坏死性凋亡相关蛋白及坏死性凋亡特征蛋白的对接能量均低于-5 kcal/mol。此外，龙胆苦苷细胞降低胃癌细胞活力并抑制增殖。动物实验结果表明，龙胆苦苷抑制胃癌异种移植肿瘤的生长。蛋白质印迹和免疫组织化学（IHC）染色显示，龙胆苦苷在体外和体内均提高p-受体相互作用蛋白激酶3（p-RIPK3）水平。结论：本研究结果揭示，坏死性凋亡参与龙胆苦苷对胃癌的抑制作用。
